prior_summary: Hierarchical learned diffusion: an internally denoised, ordered four-waypoint TCP route with orientation, gripper and within-window timing conditions the fixed joint-action epsilon diffuser. A supervised action-conditioned TCP trajectory predictor couples task geometry to decoded motor trajectories, with weak low-height lateral-sweep regularization.
applicable_conditions: The complete assigned expanded buffer_red slice: open high home, red acquisition and vertical lift, free-space buffer transport, supported red setdown and release, open vertical retreat, high blue approach, low blue closure and the beginning of its rising lift. World z is up; upright cubes, downward TCP and uncluttered tabletop transfers are demonstrated. Two causal state observations and the shared complete-demonstration normalizer are required.
termination_guidance: Use observed progress rather than a waypoint clock. Red vacating its initial region is not alone manipulation readiness: continue through release and blue acquisition unless deliberately handing the shared transition to transfer_blue. The nominal useful exit has red supported and released and blue rising with closed fingers and TCP-relative co-motion. Transfer the current history and qpos/qvel, not the internal route. This guidance is distinct from final task success, which is only the supplied red_at_goal AND blue_at_goal contract.
limitations: No IK, analytic kinematics, obstacle planner, image encoder, contact sensor, hard joint-limit constraint, action equivariance or certified recovery. The coarse route is a deterministic conditional sample of a trained auxiliary diffuser, and orientation outputs are unconstrained six-component predictions. Fixed 16-step labels cannot supply a full long-horizon route or a 32-command refinement. The learned trajectory model can be inaccurate under generated actions, and no task-performance evidence is available at design time.

config.context_inputs: two normalized 47-dimensional observations, their normalized difference and both-object world-relative geometry
config.reference: learned soft red-blue local reference; no hard active-object switch
config.route_label_sampling: event-weighted pooling within four ordered four-slot bins; increased weight for opening, closure, upward crossing of 0.26 m and vertical reversals
config.route_training_noising: 100-step cosine alpha_bar with 0.008 offset and 1e-4 floor; epsilon MSE
config.route_inference: six differentiable deterministic DDIM revisions at 99,79,59,39,19,0 from a checkpointed fixed Gaussian seed; recomputed from causal history on each motor denoising call
config.motor_backbone: public DiffusionBackbone with fixed 128,256,512 widths and 256-dimensional learned condition
config.trajectory_predictor: nonrecurrent temporal convolution of encoded action horizon, learned position features and observation context, predicting subsequent normalized TCP XYZ and six-dimensional orientation
config.auxiliary_reliability: decoded-action auxiliaries weighted by motor alpha_bar; x0 clipped to [-1.5,1.5] only for learned-trajectory losses
config.sweep_prior: soft height gate centered at 0.12 m with 0.025 m width; penalizes predicted per-slot XY displacement beyond 0.0015 m, normalized by 0.01 m; observed aligned supported approach/placement is exempt
config.selection: last EMA at the fixed declared budget; no validation-based selection
